network_cmds_sample: mkdir -p /tmp/disc-src && cd /tmp/disc-src && curl -sL --max-time 60 'https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/' -o page.html -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\ ' && head -c 2000 page.html

cd /tmp/disc-src && curl -sL --max-time 60 'https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/result/' -o result-page.html -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\ ' && grep -n -i 'disc\\|score\\|result\\|token\\|decrypt' result-page.html | grep -v 'stratoplan\\|path d=' | head -40
